Booking information

Know the arrangements before you confirm.

Every trip starts with a discussion of your dates and interests. Request the details in writing before confirming or making a payment.

  1. 01

    Your trip details.

    Confirm the activity, date, meeting arrangements, guest count and any experience requirements.

  2. 02

    Your quotation.

    Check the total price, inclusions, additional fees and payment instructions supplied by W Divers.

  3. 03

    Changes to plans.

    Ask which cancellation, rescheduling and weather terms apply to your booking.

  4. 04

    Confirmation.

    An inquiry does not reserve a place. Rely on the arrangements explicitly confirmed by W Divers.
